content.text:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the woman in <Video 1>: a young East Asian woman with long straight black hair and a black band T-shirt with a yellow-and-red flame-style band graphic on the chest.
<Subject 2> is the night convenience-store exterior of <Video 1>: a wet reflective parking surface, a green awning, a glowing white two-character sign mounted under the awning, a bright white storefront, and a metal table at the left edge of frame; in the target video the sign reads "互惠" in place of the original "全家", keeping the same white glow, two-character size, spacing and position.
<Subject 3> is the white translucent plastic bag of <Video 1>, held and lifted with both hands at the ending.
<Subject 4> is the canned drink in <Video 1> as it appears in the target video: a standard red Coca-Cola can with the white script and wave, replacing the original blue can while keeping the same size, handling and placement.
<Video 1> is the source video for the target video edit.
<Audio 1> is the synchronized audio track of <Video 1>, reused in the target video for its ambience and vocal continuity and as the voice-timbre reference for <Subject 1> (S1).

summary:
[video editing + audio reuse] The target video is an edited version of <Video 1>. <Subject 1> presents a can and sets it on the table, points at the store behind her, then lifts <Subject 3> toward the camera. The canned drink becomes <Subject 4>, the store sign becomes "互惠", the bag's snack items become Coca-Cola cans, and the closing line is replaced, ending on a close-up of the bag.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - identity anchors and performance role stay unchanged.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): partially_preserved - the parking surface, awning, storefront light and table stay the same; the glowing sign text changes from "全家" to "互惠".
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - the same white translucent bag is held and lifted.
<Subject 4> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): partially_preserved - the can category, scale, handling and placement are kept; the original blue container and lettering are replaced by the Coca-Cola red can design.
<Video 1> (shot flow, timing, framing and camera): partially_preserved - the action order, pacing and locked camera with the ending push-in are kept; only the four specified elements change.
<Audio 1>: partially_copy - the source ambience and the earlier speech are reused, and the closing line is replaced and re-performed.

detailed_description:
The target video keeps the realistic night-time exterior look of <Video 1>, with bright white storefront light on wet reflective pavement, natural color and no added stylization.
[Shot 1] A locked medium shot holds <Subject 1> (S1) center frame in the parking lot of <Subject 2>. She raises <Subject 4> in her right hand toward the camera, turning the can so its red body and white Coca-Cola script face the lens in the storefront light, holds it for a beat, then lowers it and sets it down on the metal table at the left edge of frame, where it stays standing. Without moving the camera, she turns her upper body and points back at the store behind her, and the camera tilts up with small amplitude at slow speed so the glowing white sign under the green awning is clearly readable above her shoulder: the sign, which in <Video 1> read "全家", now reads "互惠" with the same white glow, two-character size, spacing and position. She turns back to face the lens and speaks (S1), her earlier line carried over unchanged from <Audio 1> with her lips moving in sync to that reused audio. She then bends down out of the lower frame, and the top of <Subject 3>, the white translucent plastic bag, rises into the lower frame between both her hands.
[Shot 2] At 00:11.000, the shot cuts to a closer framing as <Subject 3> comes up in both her hands in front of her chest. She opens the bag's mouth toward the lens, and the camera pushes in with large amplitude at slow speed until the bag's opening fills the frame; inside, the original red chip bag, yellow packet, red-and-white box and green-capped bottle are all gone, replaced by several <Subject 4> cans packed together with their white script and wave readable through the plastic. The plastic crinkles and the cans clink lightly as she tilts the bag open, her face just above the bag's edge. As the push-in settles she speaks her closing line (S1) in the same voice carried over from <Audio 1>, <d>[Chinese] 买了一堆可乐</d>, with her lips in sync, and the video ends on the close-up of the bag filled with Coca-Cola cans.

overall_soundscape:
Night parking-lot ambience continues through the whole video: faint distant traffic and a low hum from the illuminated storefront over the wet pavement. The plastic bag crinkles as she lifts and opens it, with a light clink from the cans inside, and her voice stays clearly above the ambience.
